svg.text: 64 x 52 x 14 mm, walls 2 mm, outside edges round 4 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three tubes 4.5 dia, from the rear wall to 15.2 from the rear face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the same places as the front bosses (seen from the front:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 27 left and 27 right 21 up, 27 right 21 down); hole 2.4 through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Counterbore each from the rear face 4.2 dia, 1.4 deep (screw heads).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two clip bosses 5 dia, 5.5 long inside, 6 each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 up; pilot hole 1.7 mm, 7 deep from the rear face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four cell ribs 1.2 thick, 4 tall, 0.2 off the cell: two at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides (12 long), two at top and bottom (5 long).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foam pad 40 x 24 x 1, stuck inside the back wall, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rim is 14 from the rear face; the gasket sits on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cell drops between the ribs and lifts out freely.
